name: eevee-referenced-object-data-channel
purpose: Validate the fixed Light Info socket ABI, shared referenced-object updates, shader timestamp stability, ordinary Object Attribute behavior, initial hash-slot collision rendering, and empty/deleted/rebound target behavior.
passCriteria: The source Python test completes without an assertion or Blender error; all Light Info outputs remain enabled for every light type; material shader_compile_timestamp stays unchanged across referenced-object updates; attribute-only and attribute-plus-reference values render correctly; two light UIDs with the same initial slot in a four-slot table both render their own colors; empty and deleted references return safe defaults; rebinding resolves the replacement UID and color.
